pages.text: A new world starts with $(thing)500 storage capacity$() by default. Storage is limited by total weight. Matching items can span many stacks, and different variants can each have an entry. Hotbar and equipment items do not use that capacity.

pages.title: Footprint
pages.text: $(thing)Weight per item$() is the footprint factor divided by the item's maximum stack size, rounded up. The factor is 32 by default.$(br2)$(li)Cobblestone (stacks to 64) weighs 1.$(li)Empty buckets (stack to 16) weigh 2.$(li)Unstackable tools weigh 32.

pages.title: Item Variants
pages.text: Weight normally adds across every item in storage. Different damage, names, enchantments, or other item data can make two stacks separate variants. $(l:biginventory:gear/endant)Endant$(/l) discounts quantities beyond the first stack of a variant.
